A small business Wi-Fi checklist: 8 things to get right

For a small shop, clinic or office, Wi-Fi is part of daily work. When it fails, everything slows down. Use this checklist to find gaps.

1. Separate guest and staff Wi-Fi. Customers should not share a network with your computers, tills or files.

2. Use strong, unique passwords. Change the default router login and Wi-Fi password. Avoid the one printed on the sticker.

3. Keep equipment updated. Routers and access points need updates for security and stability.

4. Cover the whole space. Walk around with your phone and check coverage at the counter, back office and storage areas.

5. Place equipment well. Access points work best high and in open spaces, not hidden in cabinets.

6. Keep a list of what you have. Write down router model, login, internet provider and account number so you can fix problems faster.

7. Plan for backup connectivity. Ask what you would do if the internet went down for a day. Even a phone hotspot can be a stopgap.

8. Keep notes on who has access. When someone leaves your business, change shared passwords.

Take 20 minutes to go through the list. If you find gaps, a short visit can usually sort them out. We help small businesses in Toronto, Ontario with network setup and fixes. Request a quote and we will take a look.
